replication.target_description: Assigned Ferrell, Gosling, and Donnellan University of Texas, Austin showering/loneliness report; primary full report could not be acquired.

notes: Original Study 1a is available and title/DOI verified against the supplied reference. No specific outcome/test locator was supplied; the overall standardized physical-warmth-extraction composite is extracted as the broad-description match. Individual frequency, duration, and temperature correlations are different tests and were not merged. Recruited sample (51) is not assumed to equal test-specific analytic n. Replication identifier ferrell_2013 is not a resolvable DOI. Reference searches identified the primary PsychFileDrawer report URL https://www.psychfiledrawer.org/replication.php?attempt=MTg3; direct acquisition failed with DNS resolution error, and a Wayback alternative was inaccessible. No primary full text or author narrative verdict was obtained; secondary descriptions were not used to fill replication statistics or success.
